name: 14-ethoxymetopon
summary: 14-Ethoxymetopon is an opioid analog that is a derivative of metopon which has been substituted with an ethoxy group at the 14-position. It is a highly potent analgesic drug several hundred times more potent than morphine.

pharmacology.en: It is a strong agonist of the mu-opioid receptor, the same target as morphine.
pharmacology.zh: 它是μ型鴉片受體的強效促效劑，與嗎啡作用於相同的標的。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它是μ型鸦片受体的强效促效剂，与吗啡作用于相同的标的。

uses.en: It is used only in research and has never been a medicine.
uses.zh: 它只用於研究，從未成為藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它只用于研究，从未成为药物。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the opioids, cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and an overdose can stop breathing and kill. They also cause dependence, with a hard withdrawal. Its very high strength makes overdose more likely.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。鴉片類藥物會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢，過量可能使呼吸停止而致命。這類藥物也會造成依賴，戒斷過程辛苦。它的效力極強，更容易過量。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。鸦片类药物会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢，过量可能使呼吸停止而致命。这类药物也会造成依赖，戒断过程辛苦。它的效力极强，更容易过量。

fact.en: Its parent drug metopon was made in the United States around 1929 by Lyndon Small, as part of a search for a morphine substitute that would be less addictive.
fact.zh: 它的母體藥物美托酮（metopon）約在1929年由美國的Lyndon Small合成，當時是為了尋找成癮性較低的嗎啡替代品。
fact.zhHans: 它的母体药物美托酮（metopon）约在1929年由美国的Lyndon Small合成，当时是为了寻找成瘾性较低的吗啡替代品。
